definitions.gloss: early spring; the beginning of spring
definitions.explanation: The first part of spring, roughly March, when it is still cold on some days. An everyday conversational word.

examples.japanese: {春先|はるさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: It is still cold in early spring.

examples.japanese: {春先|はるさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My hay fever gets bad when early spring comes.

examples.japanese: {春先|はるさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりやすい→変わりやすい：21113_kawariyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{薄手|うすで}→薄手：31824_usude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: The weather changes easily in early spring, so it's a good idea to take a light jacket when you go out.

notes:
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (the front, the beginning).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春先|はるさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: when early spring comes
- {春先|はるさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: the winds of early spring
- {春先|はるさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from early spring on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {早春|そうしゅん}: early spring — written and literary
- ⟦{初春|しょしゅん}→初春：21709_shoshun⟧: early spring; also the New Year in greetings
